_provenance.note: LLM reading of the lens token tables; not a measurement

axes.label: age/range value continuation ↔ temporal/comparative prepositions
axes.rationale: On the negative side, the Jacobian, logit and tuned lenses all give 'range', '-range', ' ranging' and '-old', and the real-logit correlation gives ' old', ' years', ' months' and ' SD', so this end is about a numeric range or age statistic. On the positive side, the Jacobian lens and the real-logit correlation both give connectives such as ' compared', ' when', ' whilst', ' during' and ' within'.

axes.label: unit tokens after numbers ↔ prepositions/clause connectives
axes.rationale: On the negative side, the Jacobian lens gives units (' grams', ' acres', ' inches', ' GHz') and the real-logit correlation gives ' years', ' yrs', 'mm' and 'kg', so this end predicts a unit after a number. On the positive side, the Jacobian lens, tuned lens and real-logit correlation give ' during', ' after', ' following' and ' when'. The logit lens is noise.

axes.label: time/rate units (post, bpm, seconds) ↔ British spelling/biofluid nouns
axes.rationale: On the negative side, the real-logit correlation gives ' bpm', ' seconds', ' minutes' and ' after', and the Jacobian lens gives American spellings plus ' after', so this end is time and rate measures. The positive side is split: the Jacobian lens gives British spellings ('colour', 'labour'), while the real-logit correlation gives ' serum', ' plasma', ' urine' and ' of'. The logit and tuned lenses are noisy apart from ' significant'.
